cards.example_es: En las reuniones largas me muero de aburrimiento.
cards.example_en: I die of boredom in long meetings.

cards.example_en: His anger passed quickly.

cards.example_en: I'm really looking forward to seeing you.

cards.example_en: I can't be bothered to go to the gym today.

cards.example_en: Reheated food disgusts me.

cards.example_en: I'm embarrassed to speak in public.

cards.example_en: I can't bear the August heat.

cards.example_en: I have a habit of arranging books by colour.

cards.example_en: I hate queuing.

cards.example_en: Do you mind if I open the window?

cards.example_en: They argued, but made up straight away.

cards.example_en: I get on very well with my flatmate.

cards.example_en: —You broke it. —What are you talking about! It wasn't me.

cards.example_es: Yo no diría eso; simplemente es tímido.
cards.example_en: I wouldn't say that; he's just shy.

cards.example_es: A mi modo de ver, el problema es otro.
cards.example_en: The way I see it, the problem is something else.

cards.es: no estar del todo de acuerdo
cards.example_es: No estoy del todo de acuerdo contigo.
cards.example_en: I don't completely agree with you.

cards.example_en: The thing is, I don't have time.

cards.example_es: Me encanta que me cocines.
cards.example_en: I love it when you cook for me.

cards.example_en: She's passionate about photography.

cards.example_es: Se enfada si llegas tarde.
cards.example_en: He gets angry if you're late.

cards.en: to get in a bad mood

cards.example_en: You're in a very good mood today.

cards.example_es: Me alegro de verte.
cards.example_en: I'm glad to see you.

cards.example_es: Echo de menos a mi familia.
cards.example_en: I miss my family.

cards.example_es: No te preocupes por mí.
cards.example_en: Don't worry about me.

cards.example_es: Tengo miedo a las arañas.
cards.example_en: I'm afraid of spiders.

cards.example_es: Sentí mucha vergüenza cuando me caí.
cards.example_en: I felt very embarrassed when I fell.

cards.example_es: Está celoso de su hermano.
cards.example_en: He's jealous of his brother.

cards.example_es: Mis padres hablan de mí con orgullo.
cards.example_en: My parents talk about me with pride.

cards.example_es: Estoy muy orgullosa de ti.
cards.example_en: I'm very proud of you.

cards.example_en: I got very excited about the trip.

cards.example_en: The film disappointed me.

cards.example_en: I get overwhelmed when I have lots of exams.

cards.example_es: Me relajo leyendo.
cards.example_en: I relax by reading.

cards.example_en: Living with friends isn't always easy.

cards.example_en: I share a flat with two Italian girls.

cards.example_en: My flatmate cooks very well.

cards.example_en: We had an argument about money.

cards.example_en: I said sorry and we made up.

cards.example_es: Te perdono, pero que no se repita.
cards.example_en: I forgive you, but don't let it happen again.

cards.example_es: Rompió con su novio el mes pasado.
cards.example_en: She broke up with her boyfriend last month.

cards.example_es: Se enamoró de una chica de Cádiz.
cards.example_en: He fell in love with a girl from Cádiz.

cards.example_en: He's obsessive about tidiness.

cards.example_en: I get nervous if someone looks at my phone.

cards.example_es: Me fastidia que me interrumpan.
cards.example_en: It annoys me when people interrupt me.

cards.example_es: Tienes razón, lo siento.
cards.example_en: You're right, I'm sorry.

cards.example_es: Estoy de acuerdo contigo.
cards.example_en: I agree with you.

cards.example_es: —¿Me dejas tu coche? —¡Ni hablar!
cards.example_en: —Will you lend me your car? —No way!
